name: ListItem
description: Presentational row for menus, selects, palettes, and lists: leading icon, truncating label, end-aligned meta (text, Badge, Kbd, StatusDot, value), trailing icon, selection check, and a destructive tone. Consumers own semantics.

ariaRequirements: No own ARIA — the interactive wrapper (Radix Item, button, li, option) owns role, aria-selected/aria-checked, and aria-disabled.
meta is exposed to assistive tech (no aria-hidden); icon, trailingIcon, and the selected check are decorative (aria-hidden).
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-17 — axe asserted in ListItem.test.tsx and the Storybook a11y gate (parameters.a11y.test: error); consumer-owned semantics reviewed (role/focus/events belong to the interactive wrapper, ListItem itself carries no interactive ARIA); ForcedColors story verifies the forced-colors treatment (CanvasText/GrayText/Highlight/HighlightText mapping).

children.description: Primary label. Truncates with an ellipsis; never wraps.

icon.description: Leading icon node; rendered in a fixed gutter so labels column-align.

meta.description: End-aligned secondary content: muted small text, Badge, Kbd, StatusDot, or a value. Exposed to AT.

trailingIcon.description: Trailing icon after meta (chevron, external-link). Decorative.

selected.description: Renders the check indicator in the trailing position. Visual only; semantic selection belongs to the consumer.

tone.description: Destructive rows (deletions) use the error color treatment.

disabled.description: Visual disabled treatment via the canonical disabled tokens. The consumer carries aria-disabled.

highlighted.description: Parent-driven active row (combobox/palette). Radix menus work without it via [data-highlighted].

forbiddenUse: Do not add role, tabIndex, or onClick to ListItem — the interactive wrapper (Radix Item, li, option, button) owns keyboard, focus, and events.
Do not rely on selected/highlighted for semantics — they are visual only; pair them with real ARIA (aria-selected, aria-checked, data-highlighted) on the wrapper.
dense: Presentational span row: icon + truncating label + end-aligned meta (text/Badge/Kbd/StatusDot) + trailingIcon + selected check; tone neutral|destructive; the interactive wrapper owns role/focus/events

usage.description: ListItem renders the visual anatomy of a menu, select, palette, or list row: a leading icon, a truncating label, end-aligned meta content, a trailing icon, and a selection check. It is purely presentational — the interactive wrapper (a Radix Item, a native li/option, or a button) owns role, focus, and events. meta stays exposed to assistive tech since it often carries information (a shortcut, a status, a value); icon, trailingIcon, and the selected check are decorative.

bestPractices.description: Wrap ListItem in the element that owns interaction — Radix MenuItem/Item, a native li/option, or a button — and let that element carry role, tabIndex, and event handlers.
Use meta for content the user needs to hear or read (a Kbd shortcut, a StatusDot, a value); use trailingIcon only for purely decorative glyphs like a chevron.
Set tone="destructive" for irreversible actions (delete, remove) so the row picks up the error color treatment.
Do not use disabled as the only signal for a non-interactive row — pair it with aria-disabled on the wrapper so assistive tech announces the state.
